doc.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Pay and prices on the Flanagan band
summary: He earned $125 a week, cleared $117.50, and could save because rooms and meals were cheap.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Yeah. It was really quite hard. But you know as a kid you don’t care about that. I think I made I think it was $125 a week, and I cleared $117.50. You could save money, believe it or not, in 1953.
Because the rooms and the meals weren’t that expensive.
Right. Every other night it was $2.75 or maybe $3.00.
Well that experience may have put some perspective on things for you.
